title: The solution plan: decisions with reasons and alternatives
request: Turn the brief and the findings into a plan a careful data scientist would write: one decision per point, each with the findings it rests on and the alternatives set aside; the studio proposes it and a person can override a decision with a reason, as a recorded move.
spec: dclab_core.plan: brief and findings to a SolutionPlan of Decisions (framing, split, metric from the cost of errors, baselines, feature directions, families, risks, what would change the plan). Solution.propose() and the engine read it; overrides are recorded moves. Done when on the three replicas and the fraud replica the plan's decisions match the acceptance tests, every decision cites a finding, and an override reaches the engine and the log.
plan: Write plan() with one decision per key and validate(), which refuses a plan that ignores a critical finding.
Add the compact plan to Solution.propose(), read on a seeded 80% of rows, and the adapter solution_fields_from_plan.
Test the replicas' decisions; run the suites that use propose().
Run the reviewer; for adoption, reuse the studio's governed set_solution move instead of a parallel path: the intern's adopt_plan tool.
Fix the 11 findings with 12 new tests; add adopt_plan's refusal case; re-run the judgment suite for the new project tools; rd-check.

decisions.decision: Only a person's override sets a finding aside; a model's override is checked like any proposal.
decisions.why: Otherwise a model can mark a decision 'overridden' and skip the leakage checks.

decisions.decision: The grouping entity is the one the person names, else the one that tells the target out of fold, with at least 10 values.
decisions.why: Without a brief the first entity by column order was account_id with 3 values, which makes grouped folds degenerate.

decisions.decision: A plan is adopted through the existing set_solution move (graph check, log, memory, audit).
decisions.why: The main product's rule, and this repository's: no parallel system for an existing concern.

decisions.decision: propose() adds the plan beside its own fields and leaves them unchanged.
decisions.why: Many callers read the proposal; the plan is advice until it is adopted.

change: dclab_core/plan.py (plan, validate, override), core_adapter.solution_fields_from_plan, the plan in studio.solution.propose with failures logged, the intern's adopt_plan write tool through set_solution; tests/test_core_plan.py, a refusal case in tests/test_agents_validator.py.

findings.defect: plan() raised on ordinary wide tables, and the studio then dropped the plan without a word.
findings.scenario: A binary table with 25 columns whose missingness predicts the target raised a validation error (cites at most 20); through propose() the plan came back None with no log.
findings.cause: One citation per finding with no cap, and a bare except returning None.
findings.fix: Deduplicate citations and keep the first 20; log the failure's type and the target name through observe.

findings.defect: The sixth override of a decision crashed.
findings.scenario: Overriding metric.primary repeatedly grew the alternatives to 9 against a limit of 8; labels.join with 6 refused keys crashed on its third override.
findings.cause: The cap was applied before the new alternative was added.

findings.defect: A model could get past the validator.
findings.scenario: An advisor override of the split to stratified, against an entity that predicts the target, validated with no problem; overriding features.forbidden silenced every critical-leak check. Any 'by' other than the exact string 'person' was recorded as the advisor.
findings.cause: Checks were skipped for any overridden decision, whatever its source.
findings.fix: Skip a check only for a person's override; a model's override is still checked; the source is the advisor only when the advisor made it.

findings.defect: Malformed choices passed the validator or crashed it.
findings.scenario: A split given as the plain string 'stratified' was treated as having no kind and passed; a forbidden list of plain names crashed with AttributeError. These are the shapes a model is likely to send.
findings.fix: Read a string split as its kind, accept a plain string as a column name, and report any other shape as a problem.

findings.defect: The validator ignored critical label-join findings.
findings.scenario: A fraud plan joining labels on biker_id validated, though the finding that this key marks 1.5 or more rows per label is critical.
findings.cause: Only critical leakage findings were checked.
findings.fix: Refuse a join key named by an inflation finding, and any join when no key was found.

findings.defect: Without a brief, the grouping entity was chosen by column order.
findings.scenario: The studio calls plan without a brief; on the fraud replica that gave group by account_id (3 values, about 5,400 rows each) instead of biker_id (240 values).
findings.fix: Rank entities by out-of-fold power, require at least 10 values, list the others as alternatives.

findings.defect: An entity the person named was ignored when its name had spaces.
findings.scenario: A brief stating the entity 'Courier ID' gave group by account_id: the plan looked for the finding id built from the lower-cased name, while analyse slugs it.
findings.cause: Two ways of building the same id.
findings.fix: Match on the finding's column, not on its id.

findings.defect: A metric the brief named was dropped silently unless its name matched exactly.
findings.scenario: 'Judged on AUC' with 4.7% positives gave average_precision, and the reason never mentioned AUC.
findings.cause: No aliases between understand's names and the plan's.
findings.fix: An alias map (auc to roc_auc, pr_auc to average_precision, f1 to macro F1 for multiclass); a named metric still not used is recorded as an alternative with the reason.

findings.defect: The plan could order the split by a column it also kept out, and the adapter then failed.
findings.scenario: With completed_at as the first timestamp and drift, the plan split by time on completed_at and listed it to confirm; Solution() then refused a time column that is also forbidden.
findings.cause: The time column was chosen without looking at the columns kept out.
findings.fix: Never use a forbidden or to-confirm column as the time column; the adapter drops the time column from the forbidden list.

findings.defect: Target statistics included the future holdout rows, and the warning saying so was dropped.
findings.scenario: propose() called analyse without training rows, so entity power, prevalence and drift used every row; the no-split warning was neither cited nor listed as a risk.
findings.cause: No provisional split at proposal time.
findings.fix: Read the plan on a seeded 80% of rows, and cite the no-split warning in the split decision and the risks when it applies.

findings.defect: An override never reached the engine or the log, and the intern never saw the plan.
findings.scenario: override() was a pure function with no move, check or log entry; solution_fields_from_plan was called only from a test; the intern's propose_solution returned a fixed field list without the plan.
findings.cause: The governed path was not built.
findings.fix: The intern sees the plan and adopts it with adopt_plan through set_solution (graph check, log, memory, audit), refused when a model's change ignores a critical finding.

findings.defect: rd-check failed because the new write tool had no refusal case.
findings.cause: Every project write tool must show the validator refusing it.
findings.fix: Add adopt_plan's refusal case to the validator tests; rd-check then passed (914 tests).

measurements.name: plans on the replicas
measurements.gate: On the replicas the plan's decisions match the acceptance tests and every decision cites a finding (Done-when of 17.4).
measurements.result: Fraud: partial labels, the order join with inflating keys refused, folds by biker, average precision with recall at the budget, PU and anomaly families. Tickets: a forward split (a class appears late), macro F1, resolved_by kept out and first_response_minutes to confirm. Delivery: folds by restaurant, MAE with the share within tolerance, the cap, the recomputed delivery time and the rating kept out.

measurements.name: the judgment suite after the new tools
measurements.gate: The judgment suite's scores must not move when project tools are added (the prompt gate).
measurements.result: AEV-015, scripted: scores identical to AEV-014.

outcome: Done: a plan of cited decisions with alternatives, validated so that only a person may set a finding aside, adopted through the governed set_solution move; 11 review findings fixed with 12 tests. Open: the engine does not yet read the plan's secondary metrics, cleaning or directions; no person-facing route overrides one decision.
lessons: An escape hatch must check who opened it: 'overridden' is not the same as 'overridden by a person'.
Validate the shapes a model is likely to send, not only the ones your code writes.
A silent fallback (except: return None) hides exactly the inputs that need attention; log the type.
